description: Manage your Collibra data catalog: create and find assets such as business terms, set their attributes, tags, relations and owners, comment, start workflows, and follow changes to assets, comments and tasks.

collibra_asset_deleted_trigger.description: Runs when an asset is deleted.

output.activity: The record returned by the service

collibra_asset_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when an asset moves to a new status, such as Accepted.

output.activity: The record returned by the service

collibra_asset_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an asset's name, type, domain, status or other field changes.

output.activity: The record returned by the service

collibra_attribute_changed_trigger.description: Runs when an asset's attribute, such as its definition, is added, changed or removed.

output.activity: The record returned by the service

collibra_new_asset_trigger.description: Runs when an asset, such as a business term or data set, is added.

output.activity: The record returned by the service

collibra_new_comment_trigger.description: Runs when someone comments on an asset, domain or community.

output.comment: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only comments on this asset. Leave empty for every comment you can see.
parameters.name: asset_id

collibra_new_community_trigger.description: Runs when a community is created.

output.community: The record returned by the service

collibra_new_domain_trigger.description: Runs when a domain, such as a glossary, is created.

output.activity: The record returned by the service

collibra_new_relation_trigger.description: Runs when two assets are related.

output.activity: The record returned by the service

collibra_new_responsibility_trigger.description: Runs when someone is given a role, such as Owner or Steward, on an asset, domain or community.

output.activity: The record returned by the service

collibra_new_workflow_task_trigger.description: Runs when a workflow task, such as an approval, is assigned to the connected Collibra user.

output.task: The record returned by the service
